onb.welcome.title.t: Tidy your photos, safely and calmly

onb.welcome.body.t: Fjell finds duplicates and photos you probably don't need. Nothing is deleted without your say-so.
onb.welcome.body.ctx: Én setning om hva appen gjør

onb.folders.privacy.t: Your photos stay on this computer. Nothing is sent anywhere.

onb.folders.start.ctx: Primærknapp når minst én mappe er valgt

onb.noaccess.title.ctx: Tilstand: ingen mapper valgt eller ingen lesetilgang

onb.noaccess.body.t: We couldn't read any of the folders. Choose folders you have access to.

onb.scan.found.ctx: Levende tall under rask skann. {count} = antall

onb.scan.metadata.t: We only read file information; no photos are opened.

onb.done.body.ctx: {size} = formatert filstørrelse. «Frigjort» brukes bare om permanent slettet plass

home.quick.button.ctx: Primærknapp på Hjem. Åpner kortmodus (maks 20 kort)

home.expired.banner.t: {count, plural, one {# photo in the trash has expired} other {# photos in the trash have expired}}. They have not been deleted.

home.partial.banner.t: Some folders could not be read

home.clean.body.t: Nothing to clean up right now. We'll let you know when we find more.

trash.permanent.ack.t: I understand the photos will be deleted for good

trash.purged.kept.t: {count, plural, one {# photo is untouched in quarantine. Nothing has been deleted.} other {# photos are untouched in quarantine. Nothing has been deleted.}}

trash.error.body.t: Couldn't empty the trash. Nothing has been deleted.

consequence.backup_unknown.t: Fjell can't tell whether these are backed up

consequence.mass_delete.t: Many photos are moved at once

consequence.ack_required.t: You need to confirm before this can be done.

consequence.plan_stale.t: The photos have changed. Please review again.

consequence.purge_stale.t: The trash has changed. Please open it again.

setting.notify.expired.t: Notify when photos in the trash expire

restore.done.t: {count, plural, one {# photo restored} other {# photos restored}}

restore.where.t: The photos are back where they were.

restore.none.t: Pick the photos you want to restore.

home.folder.note.t: Fjell scans one folder at a time. A new folder replaces the previous one. Your photos stay on this computer.
home.folder.note.ctx: Ærlig forklaring: kjernen har ett bibliotek

home.folder.error.t: The folder wasn't found or can't be read.

home.folder.browse.ctx: Knapp ved stifeltet: åpner Windows mappevalg

home.folder.browse.title.t: Choose the folder with your photos

home.folder.browse.unavailable.t: Folder browsing isn't available here. Type the path.
home.folder.browse.unavailable.ctx: Forklaring når appen kjører uten Windows-skallet (nettleser/dev)

home.idle.body.t: Choose a folder and we'll look for duplicates and photos you probably don't need.

home.scan.start.ctx: Knapp når ingen skann har kjørt

home.scan.cancelled.t: Scan stopped. What was found is kept.

settings.trash.hint.t: Photos you move to the trash can be restored for this long. The change applies to photos you move afterwards.

settings.quarantine.body.t: Photos you move to the trash wait here until you empty or restore them. The contents of your photos are never changed.

settings.quarantine.none.t: Choose a folder first. The quarantine folder is created inside it.

settings.empty.default.t: Default: move to the Windows Recycle Bin. Permanent deletion always asks for its own confirmation, every time.
settings.empty.default.ctx: Viser standard for Tøm. Ikke et valg her

settings.error.t: Couldn't save. The setting is unchanged.

help.action.best.t: Make photo number 1 to 9 the best

a11y.photo.reason.ctx: Begrunnelse lagt til etiketten. {reason} = tekst fra reason.*

a11y.live.restored.t: {count, plural, one {# photo restored} other {# photos restored}}

a11y.keys.focusmode.t: Arrow keys need focus mode in your screen reader. The buttons always work.

a11y.ring.t: Ring showing how much can be cleaned up
a11y.ring.ctx: Dekorativ visualisering. Full tekst ligger på ett element

ui.card.suggestion.ctx: Nøytral tekst for ukjent begrunnelseskode (logges i test)

update.version.ctx: Viser installert appversjon. {version} = f.eks. 0.1.42, eller «dev» utenfor den installerte appen

update.check.ctx: Knapp. Sjekker bare når brukeren trykker

update.install.ctx: Knapp. Laster ned, installerer og starter appen på nytt

update.status.none.ctx: Statusmelding etter sjekk uten ny versjon

update.released.ctx: Dato for ny versjon. {date} = formatert dato

update.error.check.t: Could not check for updates. You may be offline, or the service is not responding. Check your internet connection and try again later. The app works as usual, and your photos are not affected.
update.error.check.ctx: Feilmelding etter mislykket sjekk. Sier hva brukeren kan gjøre

update.error.unsupported.t: Updating only works in the installed app, not in a browser or development mode.
update.error.unsupported.ctx: Feilmelding når appen kjører utenfor Tauri

update.progress.unknown.ctx: Fremdriftstekst når total størrelse er ukjent. {done} = filstørrelse

update.status.restarting.t: The update is installed. The app is restarting …

update.error.install.t: Could not install the update. The installed version is unchanged. Try again, or check your internet connection.

update.install.note.t: Fjell closes while the new version is installed, and starts again afterwards. Your photos and settings are kept.
update.install.note.ctx: Forklaring under «Installer og start på nytt», før brukeren trykker

update.error.stalled.t: The installation did not complete. The installed version is unchanged. Try again, or install manually.
update.error.stalled.ctx: Feilmelding når installasjonen startet, men appen aldri ble erstattet

update.error.incomplete.t: The update to version {version} did not complete. You are still using version {current}. Try again, or install manually.
update.error.incomplete.ctx: Vises ved oppstart når forrige installasjon ikke ble fullført. {version} = versjonen som ble forsøkt, {current} = installert versjon

update.manual.text.t: Copy the link, paste it into your browser and download the file ending in “setup.exe”. Close Fjell before you run the file. Your photos and settings are kept.
update.manual.text.ctx: Forklaring i reserveveien. Appen åpner ikke lenken selv

update.manual.failed.t: Could not copy the link. It is selected: press Ctrl+C to copy.
update.manual.failed.ctx: Feilmelding etter «Kopier lenke». Lenken er da merket i feltet

update.blocked.t: You cannot install while a scan is running. The app restarts during installation, which would interrupt the scan. Pause or cancel the scan on Home, or wait until it finishes.
update.blocked.ctx: Forklaring når «Installer og start på nytt» er deaktivert

update.auto.note.t: Off by default: the app only checks when you press “Check for update”. The request sends only the app version and operating system, never photos, paths or file names. Nothing is installed unless you press “Install and restart”.
update.auto.note.ctx: Forklaring under bryteren. Skal si hva som sendes

update.auto.error.t: Could not save the choice. The setting is unchanged.

home.update.banner.ctx: Banner på Hjem. Lenke til Innstillinger følger. {version} = ny versjon

cloud.title.t: This folder syncs with {provider, select, icloud {iCloud} onedrive {OneDrive} dropbox {Dropbox} other {a cloud service}}
cloud.title.ctx: Tittel på skyadvarsel. {provider} = icloud, onedrive eller dropbox

cloud.body.t: Moving photos to the trash here could remove them from all your devices. That is why «Move to trash» is turned off. You can still scan, see suggestions and choose «Keep».
cloud.body.ctx: Forklaring i skyadvarselen. Også beskrivelse (aria-describedby) for de deaktiverte papirkurv-knappene

cloud.tip.t: Tip: use a local copy of the folder, or export the photos to an ordinary folder, and clean up there.

cloud.caveat.t: We recognise sync folders by name. If your sync folder is named something else, we can't tell.
cloud.caveat.ctx: Ærlig forbehold i skyadvarselen: deteksjonen er et sikkerhetsnett, ikke en garanti

cloud.key.blocked.t: The trash key does nothing here: the folder syncs with a cloud service. Use «Keep» or «Skip».
cloud.key.blocked.ctx: Annonseres og vises når brukeren trykker papirkurv-tasten eller dytter kortet opp i en skysynket mappe

cloud.error.blocked.t: Nothing was moved: the folder syncs with a cloud service.
cloud.error.blocked.ctx: Feilmelding når skallet svarer cloud_synced_readonly på papirkurv-valg

thumb.error.cloud_placeholder.ctx: Forklaring i bildeflis: filen er bare en skyplassholder og leses aldri

thumb.error.corrupt.ctx: Forklaring i bildeflis når bildefilen ikke kan leses

thumb.error.not_found.ctx: Forklaring i bildeflis når filen er borte fra mappen
